text:
sarah: Heads up — noticed the Python async client (0.9.8) returns a different rerank response shape than the sync client. Async gives a wrapper dict with "results" nested under "data" while sync returns a flat list of scores. This breaks downstream batching helpers.
kevin: ugh. can you paste a tiny repro?
sarah: ```py
# async repro
resp = await client.rerank.async_rerank(
  model="rerank-small",
  queries=["q1"],
  candidates=[["a", "b"]]
)
# expected: resp.scores -> [0.9, 0.1]
# actual: resp == {"data": {"results": [[0.9, 0.1]]}}
```
mike: i saw similar when using EmbedBatcher; embed helper flattens to List[ndarray] but rerank helper expects List[float] and tries indexing directly.
julia: sounds like two problems: (1) parsing layer wraps async httpx responses differently, (2) typing/models diverged so pydantic output keys mismatch.
ci-bot: test: test_async_rerank_response_shape failed on main — 1 failing (cc @eng-ml)
kevin: filed issue #4123 — the async adapter skips the token refresh branch on 401 so we see weird 403s and then fallback codepath returns a different shape.
omar: short-term workaround: unwrap with `data = resp.get('data') or resp` then `results = data.get('results') or data` to normalize. Also `listify(results)` before passing to batcher.
sarah: onboarding friction: sample-app still uses sync-only examples (sync.rerank(...)) which misleads folks trying async. we should add explicit async sample and note normalized shape in the docs.
mike: i can draft a PR to make RerankResponse tolerant: accept both top-level list or {data:{results:...}} then map to `.results` attribute. prefer non-breaking shim.
julia: agree — add deprecation warning if old shape seen for one release, but keep mapping. also add pydantic union on the model: `results: Union[List[float], Dict[str, Any]]` then normalize in `.post_init__`
sarah: can someone add an integration test that exercises: async client + token refresh + rerank + batcher pipeline? that will catch both auth and shape regressions. tagging @eng-qa
omar: i'll add the test and a small fix for the async token refresh today.
kevin: also please update sample-app README with an explicit `async` section and a note about `embed_batcher` input types.
sarah: :thumbsup: thanks. Action items:
- mike: PR for tolerant RerankResponse shim + change log note
- omar: async token refresh fix + integration test
- kevin: sample-app async example + README update
- eng-qa: add regression test to CI matrix
we should avoid breaking any public fields; prefer mapping layer.
sarah: closing — follow up in the PR thread.
